title: How a Sink P-Trap Protects Indoor Air
description: The P-trap is a critical component of sink drainage designed to isolate living spaces from harmful sewer gases. As wastewater discharges down the tailpiece, gravity carries most of the water out through the trap arm into the wall drain. However, the dip in the P-trap retains a standing column of clean water, known as the trap seal. This standing water forms an airtight barrier that prevents volatile organic compounds and hazardous gases from traveling up from the main sewer line, while allowing subsequent waste streams to pass freely through hydraulic displacement.

How a Sink P-Trap Protects Indoor Air

The P-trap is a critical component of sink drainage designed to isolate living spaces from harmful sewer gases. As wastewater discharges down the tailpiece, gravity carries most of the water out through the trap arm into the wall drain. However, the dip in the P-trap retains a standing column of clean water, known as the trap seal. This standing water forms an airtight barrier that prevents volatile organic compounds and hazardous gases from traveling up from the main sewer line, while allowing subsequent waste streams to pass freely through hydraulic displacement.
